user.title: Add a Knit device
user.description: Knit your sensors into a smart device. Its settings can also be changed on its Knit card.

menu_options.light: Light: motion control and light level
menu_options.auto_off_switch: Motion-controlled device: off once the room is empty (presence never turns it on)
menu_options.appliance: Appliance: running / full / empty from its power (a dishwasher, a washing machine)

light.title: Light
light.description: Pick the light (or a plug-controlled light's switch) and the sensors it should follow.

data.name: Name
data.presence: Presence sensors (occupied while any is on)
data.pause: Pause while these are on (e.g. guests)
data.start_on: Turn its automatic features on now

data_description.presence: Motion uses these. Leave empty for no motion control.
data_description.illuminance: One or more. With several, their average is used, so a room without a sensor can follow the rooms around it.
data_description.pause: Knit leaves it alone while they're on: nothing turns it on or off by itself, and its card says Automations paused.
data_description.start_on: Leave this off if an automation already controls it, so the two don't both act on it.
data_description.pause_match: With several pause entities: any one of them on, or only once all of them are.
data_description.people: While all of them are away, nothing turns the light on (presence, the dark), but it still goes off as usual. Someone coming home to an occupied, dark room turns it on.

auto_off_switch.title: Motion-controlled device
auto_off_switch.description: A device that should go off once nobody's around.

data.name: Name
data.presence: Presence sensors (occupied while any is on)
data.pause: Pause while these are on (e.g. guests)
data.off_after_outage: Off again if it comes back on after a power cut

data_description.presence: It goes off once these have all been clear for its timeout. Presence never turns it on.
data_description.off_after_outage: For a device that shouldn't come back on by itself.
data_description.pause: Knit leaves it alone while they're on: nothing turns it on or off by itself, and its card says Automations paused.

data_description.pause_match: With several pause entities: any one of them on, or only once all of them are.

appliance.title: Appliance
appliance.description: A dishwasher, washing machine or dryer on a smart plug that reports power.

data_description.power: Its smart plug's power. Running once it's been above Running above for a while; finished once it's been below it for a while.
data_description.door: On = open. Open for a while once it's not drawing power: emptied.
data_description.empty_name: Its status once emptied (and before the first cycle).
data_description.running_name: Its status while a cycle runs.
data_description.full_name: Its status once a cycle has finished, until it's emptied.

abort.already_configured: This is already a Knit device.

error.same_names: Give each status a different name.
